overview_description.description: GoodShip is a freight orchestration and procurement platform that streamlines how shippers manage transportation data, bids, and carrier relationships. It integrates tender, contract, performance, and market rate data into a unified dashboard that enables more informed decision-making and efficient RFP processes. The platform supports AI-powered bid recommendations, scenario modelling, carrier scorecards, and in-app messaging, making it easier to align stakeholders and manage corrective actions. GoodShip plugs seamlessly into existing TMS systems and is purpose-built to enhance collaboration between procurement and operations teams.

product.name: Transportation Procurement
product.description: A platform feature that enables running custom procurement events, from mini-bids to annual RFPs, with embedded performance and market rate data and automated bid analysis.

product.name: Analytics and Recommendations
product.description: A feature that unifies spend, carrier performance, contract, market rate, and budget data to provide actionable recommendations for cost reduction and performance improvement.

product.name: Carrier Management
product.description: A tool to invite carriers, share self-service scorecards, and manage carrier performance within a centralized platform.

product.name: Collaboration
product.description: An in-app messaging and commenting system that centralizes communication and keeps vital procurement and operational details organized within the platform.
